name: Choir Pad
description: Forty bands rise gently and linger for three seconds. Choose a sustained synth track as the external carrier.

name: Formant Down
description: The voice is its own carrier, rebuilt with the synthesis bands seven semitones lower.

name: Formant Up
description: The voice is its own carrier, rebuilt with the synthesis bands seven semitones higher.

name: Gated Vowels
description: A noise carrier holds each vowel for an eighth note, following the project's tempo map.

name: Robot Voice
description: Sixteen bands for a classic talking synth. Choose a synth track as the external carrier; until a source is chosen, the vocoder is silent.

name: Scrambled Speech
description: The voice drives a fixed scrambled patch of sixteen synthesis bands, turning familiar words into a texture.

name: Singing Saw
description: A saw follows one clear voice between 80 and 1000 Hz, keeping its last note through pauses.

name: Telephone Talker
description: Eight bands from 300 Hz to 3.4 kHz remake the voice with a narrow, telephone-like range.

name: Tuned Robot
description: A pitch-tracked pulse snaps to the project's scale before its glide: the voice sings its notes.

name: Whisper
description: Dense noise follows the voice in twenty-four bands: a pitched voice becomes a whisper, with a little of its own highs keeping the consonants clear.

name: Wide Choir
description: A synth carrier lingers for a second, with alternating bands hard left and right. Choose its external source track before playing.
